text: Nothing was destroyed. I read the merge (327aee3) against main as it was. It deletes no files, and only 8 lines change in place across 21 files (87 lines added). What CL10 added: 12 screenshots in docs/cl10; a guard so the tests never write to ~/.local/bin; 4 CSS lines (the post's button bar fits the phone, the section chevron is centred, the waiting clock is gray); and a fix for 2 test failures that were already on main. All 7 suites pass, and every item in WHAT-NOT-TO-BREAK.md is still there (checked separately). The other parts merge main into their branches first and keep both sides.
